notices.title: 🪔 The temple has been rearranged
notices.body: Books, art and teachings each have one home now. Learning lives in the new Path tab.

notices.title: 🪔 The temple has grown
notices.body: A new Mandir tab, the Varaha Avatar katha in 52 painted scenes, the Hanuman Chalisa reborn as a cinematic book, free Darshan wallpapers — including the new Deity Darshan pack — and a completely new daily sadhana experience. The temple gives freely. More is coming.
